entries.title: Clear Attribute Values on Selected Blocks
entries.summary: Clears the text value of every attribute attached to user-selected attributed block references.
when_to_use: Selected blocks contain stale or unwanted attribute values that should be blanked before downstream processing.
inputs: User selection of attributed block references
effects: Sets each selected attribute TextString to an empty string
implementation_notes: Current implementation only clears attribute values; it does not repair duplicate tags or normalize attribute constraints.
TBH header metadata was normalized on 2026-09-17 without changing function logic.

entries.title: Remove SOLID/TRACE/3DFACE, Solid Hatches and Wipeouts
entries.summary: Scans every block definition/space and deletes AcDbSolid, AcDbTrace, AcDb3dFace, SOLID-pattern hatches and wipeouts, then regenerates the drawing.
when_to_use: Preparing imported/Xref source drawings where those object types are intentionally disposable.
implementation_notes: The implementation does not purge DGN linetypes, regapps or other unreferenced data; registry and TBH header now describe the actual geometry cleanup only.
Function logic was not changed during the 2026-09-17 metadata review.

entries.title: Strip MText Formatting Overrides
entries.summary: Parses selected MTEXT content, removes embedded formatting control sequences, and rewrites DXF text as simplified plain content.
when_to_use: Imported MText carries local formatting that should be normalized, after confirming that complex stacked or escaped content is not required.
effects: Rewrites MTEXT DXF group 1/3 text after parser-based formatting removal
implementation_notes: Known static-review issue: the parser skips content after \S until the terminating semicolon, so stacked fractions/content can be lost rather than merely unformatted.

Known static-review issue: generic backslash escape handling can skip escaped/literal content until a semicolon, and the final vl-string-subst calls remove only the first opening and closing brace occurrence.
These function issues were documented on 2026-09-17 and intentionally not repaired in this phase.

entries.title: Purge Reconciled Layer Metadata and Disable Notifications
entries.summary: On load or command execution, attempts to remove ADSK_XREC_LAYER_RECONCILED from every layer extension dictionary, then deletes each layer extension dictionary and sets LAYEREVAL/LAYERNOTIFY to 0.
when_to_use: Only when reconciliation metadata and layer notification state are intentionally being reset and the extension-dictionary deletion risk is acceptable.
effects: Attempts to remove ADSK_XREC_LAYER_RECONCILED from every layer extension dictionary
Deletes each layer extension dictionary after the removal attempt
implementation_notes: The file invokes c:PURGERECONCILEDLAYERS at top level, so loading the file immediately mutates the active drawing.

Known static-review issue: after attempting to remove the reconciliation XRecord, the source calls vla-delete on the entire layer extension dictionary; unrelated extension-dictionary metadata may therefore be removed. Function logic was intentionally not repaired in this phase.

entries.title: Move Xref References to Standard XREF Layer
entries.summary: Attempts to create/configure layer XREF (ACI 254), identify Xref block references, temporarily handle source-layer lock state, and move those references to XREF.
when_to_use: Standardizing host-drawing Xref references onto one coordination layer after the known -LAYER lock-option issue has been validated or repaired.
effects: Moves identified Xref references to XREF when execution reaches the remap path
Attempts to temporarily change and restore source-layer lock state
implementation_notes: Known static-review issue: the source uses -LAYER option shorthand "l" in paths intended to lock a layer. AutoCAD command syntax may resolve this as Linetype rather than Lock (which normally requires LO), so the layer-lock path may fail or behave differently from the intended description.
The function was not repaired in this phase; runtime validation/fix is deferred.

entries.title: Map Imported/Xref Layers to Standard Coordination Layers
entries.summary: Creates a standard coordination layer set, derives source-to-target mappings from keyword rules, remaps drawing objects and nested block content, handles locked layers, prompts when mapped targets are off/frozen, and removes obsolete source layers after mapping.
when_to_use: Normalizing consultant/imported/Xref layer systems into the project's standard coordination layers.
A project-specific mapping variant is needed without permanently editing the managed library source.
inputs: Runtime/project mapping rules when using dynamic mode
User choice if mapped target layers are off or frozen
effects: Creates missing standard target layers with configured ACI/linetype
Remaps entities and nested block content
May delete objects mapped to off/frozen targets when the user chooses Delete
Deletes empty obsolete source layers after mapping when AutoCAD permits deletion
dynamic_parameters: target layer definitions (name, ACI color, linetype)
implementation_notes: The managed library file is normal AutoLISP. ai_mode=dynamic only permits bounded AI-derived runtime variants; it is not a Lisp source type.
TBH header metadata was normalized on 2026-09-17 without changing mapping logic. Live CAD behavior validation remains a later-phase task.

entries.title: TBH Toolkit Command
entries.summary: Transitional Job that resolves a registered TBH Lisp command, verified-loads its managed source, dispatches it to the bound drawing, and reports interactive state.
